CREATE TABLE `pc_atomic_memory_current` (
  `scope_id` varchar(256) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,
  `artifact_id` varchar(128) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,
  `revision` bigint(20) NOT NULL,
  `state_version` bigint(20) NOT NULL,
  `content_hash` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,
  `projection_format` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL,
  `kind` mediumtext NOT NULL,
  `text` mediumtext NOT NULL,
  `searchable_text` mediumtext NOT NULL,
  `tag_keys` mediumtext NOT NULL,
  `embedding` VECTOR(__DIMENSION__) DEFAULT NULL,
  `profile_fingerprint` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `embedding_input_hash` varchar(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`scope_id`, `artifact_id`),
  FULLTEXT KEY `ix_pc_atomic_memory_current_fts` (`searchable_text`) WITH PARSER space PARSER_PROPERTIES=(min_token_size=3,max_token_size=84) BLOCK_SIZE 16384,
  VECTOR KEY `ix_pc_atomic_memory_current_embedding` (`embedding`) WITH (DISTANCE=L2,TYPE=HNSW, LIB=VSAG, M=16, EF_CONSTRUCTION=200, EF_SEARCH=64) BLOCK_SIZE 16384,
  CONSTRAINT `ck_pc_atomic_memory_current_revision` CHECK ((`revision` > 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_pc_atomic_memory_current_state_version` CHECK ((`state_version` >= 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `ck_pc_atomic_memory_current_embedding_metadata` CHECK ((((`embedding` is null) and (`profile_fingerprint` is null) and (`embedding_input_hash` is null)) or ((`embedding` is not null) and (`profile_fingerprint` is not null) and (`embedding_input_hash` is not null))))
) DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4
